subject: [COMPANY]' CV Models | Working with RightHand Robotics & Agile Robots
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Congrats on making The Robot Report's list of the most innovative robotics companies - great to see how you're driving innovation in the space!

I'm reaching out because we're currently working with teams at RightHand Robotics, Agile Robots, Toyota-Woven and a few others on similar warehouse logistics and robotics challenges-especially around improving model performance and delivery speed, while keeping development costs in check as they scale.

text:
